description.value: Kermode Wild Berry Winery is a premium alpine winery established in 2005 in Dewdney, BC, specializing in 100% wild organic berry and fruit wines — including what it claims is the only Pure Alpine Wild Blueberry Wine produced anywhere in the world. The winery sources wild blueberries by hand from the forests of Northern BC each summer and produces over 600,000 bottles annually across a broad range of styles from dry table wines to ports and ice wines. Named after the rare Kermode 'Spirit Bear' of Northern BC, it has earned international awards and is considered one of Canada's largest fruit wine producers.
